correct_transition_examples.relevant_characteristic: Large cross-panel jump from the last carousel indicator on the left image panel to the forgot password control on the right form panel; useful as a confirmed example of a wrap/reordering transition.
Confirmed jump from the password field back to the first carousel indicator, showing implemented tab order cycling from right-side form content to left-side decorative/navigation dots.
Normal within-form forward movement between adjacent text inputs; useful contrast against the nonlocal jumps labeled as LNFs.
Normal progression among closely related form controls on the right panel; useful comparison to separate acceptable grouping from disruptive wrap behavior.
Expected sequential movement within the carousel indicator cluster; useful contrast to the jump that occurs after the last indicator.

subject_summary: No FP or FN records are present in the supplied evaluated_transitions for cgtn. The original predictions exactly match the two ground-truth LNF transitions, and both are classified as TP. The main observable characteristic of the confirmed LNFs is wrap-like movement between the left-side carousel indicator cluster and the right-side login form, while adjacent movements within the indicator cluster and within the form are treated as non-errors.
